hints.title: Identify Smallest Unaccounted Amount
hints.text: The smallest positive amount where the target count exceeds current generated ways must be an active coin denomination.

hints.title: Forward Knapsack Reconstruction
hints.text: Whenever a new denomination is discovered, update current combinations via unbounded knapsack transitions.

hints.title: Sequential Coin Revelation
hints.text: Repeat amount by amount from 1 up to maximum target sum to reconstruct all sorted denominations.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: M: maximum amount in dp array
complexity.notes: Greedy inverse knapsack simulating forward combinations per discovered coin.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all 2^M coin subsets is exponentially impossible.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Rolling 1D knapsack array uses O(M) working memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deduce that the first discrepancy between dp and current ways identifies the next coin.
